تستهلكي (form X)
# تَسْتَهْلِكِي (tastahlikī) /tas.tah.li.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# تُسْتَهْلَكِي (tustahlakī) /tus.tah.la.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
